connect.title: How to connect
connect.subtitle: Three steps: create an account, pick your game version, follow the steps.
connect.accountText: Register an account on this site. It is separate from your official osu! account and the password is not shared.
connect.stableShortcutTitle: Option A: make a shortcut (no extra tools)
stableShortcutSteps: Find osu!.exe, right-click it and choose Create shortcut. Put the shortcut on your desktop.
Right-click the new shortcut and choose Properties.
In the Target field, go to the very end, type one space, then paste the text below. Do not change the existing path.
Click OK. Always start the game from this shortcut and sign in with your account from this site.
connect.stableShortcutNote: To play on the official servers again, just start the original osu!.exe. The shortcut does not affect it.
connect.stableToolTitle: Option B: use the Kaleidoscope launcher
stableToolSteps: Download and extract Kaleidoscope. Keep all files in one folder.
Open Kaleidoscope and pick your osu!.exe.
Press Launch. The game connects to this server; sign in with your account.
lazerSteps: Download and extract Kaleidoscope. Keep all files in one folder.
Open Kaleidoscope and pick your installed official osu!lazer.
Press Launch, then sign in with your account from this site.
When you close the game, Kaleidoscope cleans up the connection files automatically.
connect.lazerNote: Your beatmap library and game settings are reused. Only the account sign-in data is kept separate. Linux supports lazer (choose osu.AppImage) and is still experimental.
connect.downloadUnavailable: The download link is not public yet. Ask the server administrator.
connect.copyError: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it manually.
helpItems: Public servers need no extra setup. On an administrator's local test setup (for example illya.test), the hosts file and test certificate must be configured first; see the operator documentation.
Going back to the official servers
For stable, start the original osu!.exe. For lazer, closing the game normally lets Kaleidoscope restore everything. If the launcher exited abnormally, open it again and it will clean up.
Sign-in, play, chat and score submission have been tested on stable and lazer. Multiplayer and spectating are still being verified and may have problems.

adminRecalc.intro: Recalculate pp for stored scores after a calculation change or to fix wrong values. Choose which scores to include, preview the match, then start a job. Failed and rejected scores and restricted players are never recalculated, and only one job can run at a time.
